spans.text: Whole brain regression in SPM8 revealed that CAPS score was inversely correlated with gray matter in a large cluster comprising the subgenual anterior cingulate cortex (sgACC, BA25), caudate nucleus, and hypothalamus ( Table 2 , Fig. 1 ).
